Container.Name: athena
Container.Overview: Athena answers Describe It in Ithaca, the Plex app for Apple TV, iPhone and iPad. You type what you're in the mood for, and the AI model you choose (Claude, GPT, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek or a local model) picks from your own Plex library, with titles to request when Seerr is connected. Only people with access to your Plex server can use it. Run it next to Plex and Seerr. After installing, open the WebUI, sign in with Plex and choose an AI model. Keep port 8800 so your household's Ithaca finds Athena by itself; friends away from home reach it through your reverse proxy, like Seerr. Settings open on port 8801, from your home network only: never put a proxy in front of that one.
Container.Requires: A Plex Media Server, and an API key from Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, xAI or DeepSeek or a local model server such as Ollama. Ithaca for Plex with Ithaca Pro on your devices.

Config.Name: API port
Config.Description: Keep 8800: Ithaca looks for Athena on this port on your Plex server's address. Point a reverse proxy for friends here.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: Settings and Automations, which open only from your home network. Keep 8801, and never put a reverse proxy or tunnel in front of it.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Settings, including your API keys (readable only by Athena), and the request log.

Config.Name: Anthropic API key
Config.Description: Optional: set it in the WebUI instead. Set here, it wins and the WebUI shows it locked.

Config.Name: OpenAI API key
Config.Description: Optional: set it in the WebUI instead. Set here, it wins and the WebUI shows it locked.

Config.Name: Gemini API key
Config.Description: Optional: set it in the WebUI instead. Set here, it wins and the WebUI shows it locked.

Config.Name: xAI API key
Config.Description: Optional: set it in the WebUI instead. Set here, it wins and the WebUI shows it locked.

Config.Name: DeepSeek API key
Config.Description: Optional: set it in the WebUI instead. Set here, it wins and the WebUI shows it locked.

Config.Name: TypeSafe API key
Config.Description: Optional: library picks from Jev. Can be set in the WebUI instead.

Config.Name: Audiobookshelf URL
Config.Description: Optional, for automations: your Audiobookshelf address, such as http://192.168.1.10:13378. Can be set in the WebUI instead.

Config.Name: Audiobookshelf API key
Config.Description: Optional, for automations: an API key from an Audiobookshelf user who can update books. Can be set in the WebUI instead.

Config.Name: Plex URL
Config.Description: Optional: your Plex server's address, such as http://192.168.1.10:32400. Leave empty to choose the server in the WebUI.

Config.Name: Provider
Config.Description: Optional: anthropic, openai, gemini, xai, deepseek or local. Can be set in the WebUI instead.

Config.Name: Model
Config.Description: Optional: the model's id, which also picks its provider. Can be set in the WebUI instead.
